title: Personalized ChatGPT-supported Python practice exercises
summary: High-school students in the intervention group use a read-only platform to request predefined, profile-adapted explanations, examples, exercises, and solutions across an introductory Python syllabus. A teacher remains present to resolve errors and misconceptions.

sources.title: Leveraging ChatGPT for Adaptive Learning through Personalized Prompt-based Instruction: A CS1 Education Case Study
sources.evidence_quote: within each subsection, a triad of prompts was designed to encompass various dimensions of learning: explanation, example, and exercise

assessment.summary: Solve personalized Python exercises generated through predefined prompts after reviewing tailored explanations and examples.
student_actions: Select syllabus topics and request predefined explanations or examples.
Request a programming exercise without its answer.
Solve the exercise, then request the separate solution when needed.

student_role.description: Students use a course platform that sends predefined, profile-personalized prompts to GPT-3.5-Turbo; free-form prompting is unavailable.

allowed_purposes: View exercise solutions after attempting them

assessment_system_role: Personalize explanations, examples, exercises, and solutions from anonymized learner-profile data

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.

evidence_excerpts.quote: within each subsection, a triad of prompts was designed to encompass various dimensions of learning: explanation, example, and exercise
